context.transcript:
Hello, Martin.
I haven't seen you since you got promoted.
Congratulations.
How's it been going so far?
There's been a lot of paperwork and emails to take care of, but next week will be better.
A new staff member is joining my team starting on Monday.
I'm sure that'll be a big help.
By the way, I'm about to take a representative from Garland Chemistry, our new client, out to lunch.
Care to join us?
My business plan for next quarter is due in two hours.
I just got started on it yesterday.
Good luck with that.
context.transcript_translation:
你好，Martin。
自从你升职后我就没见到你了。
恭喜你。
到目前为止进展如何？
有很多文书工作和电子邮件需要处理，但下周会好一些。
一位新员工从周一开始加入我的团队。
我相信这对会有很大的帮助。
顺便说一句，我正带一位来自 Garland Chemistry 的代表去吃午饭，他们是我们的新客户。
要不要加入我们？
我下个季度的商业计划书要在两个小时内交了。
我昨天才刚开始做。
祝你好运。
